St John's River Defense System

Background.

The subject area for this study is located just north of the city of St Georges, in the South-

Western end of the island. The river, near its estuary, is traversed by the main highway

linking St Georges to the north of the island and critical communities such as Victoria,

Gouyave and Marigot.

Extreme flood events within the project area that stakeholders note occurred in 1998, 2002,

2003, 2008 and 2011. The project area is vulnerable to regular flooding³ from St Johns

River, and the current standard of protection is low and below that acceptable for an urban

area such as the River Road area, which includes residential and commercial properties as

well as the national stadium of Grenada. The social impacts are particularly significant
